title: Golden question
description: One JSONL row for the eval harness. The real question file is backend/eval/golden.jsonl (owned by the golden-set issue). The committed sample uses FAKE document ids and page 999.

answerable.description: False when the correct behavior is a contract refusal.

expected.description: Document pages that support an answerable question. Empty when the question is unanswerable and no page should be cited.

part_id.description: Optional bay-map part id. Same field name as the highlight contract. Omit when the question names no mapped part.

ci.description: True includes the row in the fast CI subset. Omit or false for the full run only.

expected_value.description: Optional labeled spec number. Omit when the row has no expected value. Tests use a fake number such as 999.

unit.description: Optional unit for expected_value. Used when label_status is ok.

source_page.description: Optional PDF page that the label was read from. Not a scored field.

source_quote.description: Optional quote that supports the label. Not a scored field. Do not invent one.

label_status.description: ok rows with a non-empty expected_value are scored. needs_review rows are excluded. Omit when the row has no label.
